sequencing_note: Per context/product-intent/vision-and-differentiation.md's depth-over-breadth guidance and Requirements Rev2's MVP/Post-MVP classification: Phases A-E are the tenant-neutral MVP queue (webhook + one OPC + simulated action, through Confidence Engine + Policy Gate + Verification) and are NOT blocked by any OI-CTX tenant fact. Phase F is Post-MVP (engineering-change action). Phase G is explicitly BLOCKED -- real pilot/connector work that only real tenant facts can unblock. Phase H is the RAT-01 genericity gate, needing both F and G.
effort_note: S/M/L sizing only -- no team_velocity input was provided, so no fabricated point estimates.

stories.title: Core domain contracts: IncomingRequest, OperationalProcedureContract, ProposedAction, PolicyDecision, ExecutionResult, Evidence
acceptance_criteria: Zod schema + inferred type per contract in packages/contracts/src/schemas/, field-for-field matching spec §4's YAML
ProposedAction includes accountable_principal_id and risk_assessment.blast_radius's 5-component JSON shape (LLD §2)
PolicyDecision includes hard_deny_reason_code (enum) + hard_deny_detail, and requires_proposer_approver_separation (LLD §2/§3)
ExecutionResult includes executor_build_hash (LLD §0, OI-REQ-10)
Evidence includes retention_expires_at, retention_policy_version, legal_hold (LLD §2, ADR-011)

stories.title: Supporting contracts: ExecutionState, ContextPackage, ActionDefinition, ConnectorDescriptor, ExecutionAuthorization, PreflightResult, OPCMatchResult
acceptance_criteria: ExecutionState.state enum includes EXECUTION_UNCERTAIN (LLD §4, ADR-004/gate 5)
ActionDefinition includes compensation_class (REVERSIBLE|COMPENSATABLE|IRREVERSIBLE) + risk_scoring_ref, consistency-validated against reversible per ADR-001
ConnectorDescriptor includes definition_version, supports_correlation, is_idempotent, reliability_level (LLD §2, ADR-004/007, OI-REQ-10)
VerificationResult.checks[].name constrained to the formal enum from LLD §2 (incl. ROLE_SEPARATED_REVIEW)

stories.title: New LLD tables' contracts: execution_step_marker, outbox_event, identity_principal
acceptance_criteria: execution_step_marker schema matches LLD §2 exactly, including the tenant_id-leading UNIQUE(tenant_id, execution_id, step_id, operation_id) constraint
outbox_event schema matches LLD §2's full field list (event_id distinct from row id, aggregate_type/id/version, event_schema_version, available_at)
identity_principal includes is_development_principal, roles[]
Prisma schema.prisma updated additively; migration generated and reviewed

stories.title: Validate OPC A/B/C (spec §35) against the OPC schema
acceptance_criteria: All three OPC definitions parse cleanly through OperationalProcedureContract's Zod schema
No OPC requires a runtime code branch to represent -- schema/runtime abstraction proven complete at the contract level

stories.title: Webhook trigger adapter + IncomingRequest normalization
acceptance_criteria: A webhook POST produces a schema-valid IncomingRequest (F-01 MVP)
Raw trigger payload preserved separately via raw_payload_ref
No trigger-specific field readable outside the trigger adapter

stories.title: OPC matcher + deterministic margin guardrail
acceptance_criteria: Exact-filter matching plus margin-bounded semantic fallback works against one configured OPC (F-02 MVP)
An intentionally ambiguous ticket (margin below minimum_required_margin) yields AMBIGUOUS_ESCALATE, never an auto-pick
OPCMatchResult (all candidates) written to the Evidence Ledger unconditionally

stories.title: Durable orchestrator state machine skeleton, including EXECUTION_UNCERTAIN
acceptance_criteria: Every transition persists state + emits PlatformEvent + writes Evidence, all three, same order, every time (RULE 7)
State machine implements the full stateDiagram in LLD §4, including all three proof-gated exits from EXECUTION_UNCERTAIN
Re-delivering the same trigger is a no-op (idempotency key per spec §31)

stories.title: Simulated context connectors (application/runtime/evidence)
acceptance_criteria: Implements ContextConnector interface against fixture/fake data, not a real system
ContextPackage.missing_context and stale_context populate correctly when a fixture is configured as unavailable/stale
Never exposes a write operation through the connector interface (NFR-02)

stories.title: Investigator agent integration
acceptance_criteria: Every factual claim in the diagnosis traces to an evidence_id -- no invented connector results (F-05)
Hypotheses marked supported/rejected/unresolved explicitly

stories.title: Planner agent integration + Frozen Plan Rule
acceptance_criteria: After approval, executor cannot add/substitute an action outside the approved plan (F-06)
A changed parameter on an approved step forces re-approval, never silently proceeds

stories.title: IdentityResolver interface + local dev-principal implementation
acceptance_criteria: Resolves an actor reference to identity, tenant_id, roles, risk-class approval permission (LLD §5) -- built at MVP per ADR-012's correction, not deferred
Dev principals are a static config list, clearly flagged is_development_principal: true
Resolves both IncomingRequest.requester and ApprovalDecision.actor through the same table

stories.title: Versioned Action Registry (registry mechanics only)
acceptance_criteria: ActionDefinition versioned, status active|disabled, lookup always by tenant_id + action_ref + version (F-07)
Every ActionDefinition validates/executes through the identical ActionConnector interface regardless of kind -- no runtime branch on action kind (RULE 8)

stories.title: Policy Engine: two-phase evaluation, fixed hard-deny checks, fail-closed
acceptance_criteria: HARD_DENY_CHECKS is a fixed, code-level list in packages/policy-engine/src/hard-deny.ts -- NOT loaded from tenant config (LLD §3, gate 4)
test_hardDeny_cannotBeOverriddenByAnyPolicyRule() passes: a tenant policy trying to ALLOW an unregistered action still returns DENY
Any evaluation exception/timeout/malformed-rule/missing-input resolves to DENY(POLICY_EVALUATION_FAILED), never REQUIRE_APPROVAL
PolicyDecision.requires_proposer_approver_separation set from any matched rule that sets it (consumed later by C-04, not enforced here)
Same ProposedAction + policy version evaluated twice produces a byte-identical PolicyDecision (NFR-05)

stories.title: Approval Acceptance Gate (corrected separation-of-duties flow)
acceptance_criteria: Resolves the candidate approver's identity via IdentityResolver AFTER PolicyDecision exists, per LLD §5's corrected sequence -- separation-of-duties is NOT checked inside Policy Engine Phase 2
When requires_proposer_approver_separation is true, approver_principal_id == accountable_principal_id is rejected, routed to a different approver
No ExecutionAuthorization issued until every check (identity resolved, role permits risk class, separation satisfied) passes
POST /tenants/{tenantId}/approvals/{approvalId}/decision implemented per LLD §6

stories.title: SecretResolver interface + local env-var implementation
acceptance_criteria: Connectors resolve secrets only via SecretResolver, never a concrete SDK directly (ADR-009)
test_executeRead_neverExposesSecretValue() passes for every connector built against this interface

stories.title: Simulated ActionConnector
acceptance_criteria: Implements the full ActionConnector interface (validateAction/preflight/execute/rollback) against a fake/sandboxed target (F-18 MVP)
Proves the complete governed pipeline end-to-end without a real production mutation
execute() rejects when called without a resolved ExecutionAuthorization

stories.title: Preflight/drift check (MATCH/DRIFTED/UNKNOWN)
acceptance_criteria: Runs immediately before every execute() call (F-10)
DRIFTED blocks execution unconditionally; UNKNOWN (preflight failure) treated as missing required context, never an implicit pass
A deliberately staged drift against the simulated connector's preconditions is caught and blocks execution

stories.title: Verification Engine
acceptance_criteria: FAILED/INCONCLUSIVE never marks the ticket resolved (F-13)
recommended_next_step always populated (CLOSE/ROLLBACK/ESCALATE)
ROLLBACK is only ever recommended for REVERSIBLE/COMPENSATABLE actions, never IRREVERSIBLE ones

stories.title: Rollback decision gate: REVERSIBLE/COMPENSATABLE/IRREVERSIBLE
acceptance_criteria: Three-class distinction present and validated at registration (ADR-001, F-14 MVP gate)
IRREVERSIBLE actions never attempt rollback -- verification failure escalates directly
Simulated MVP action is explicitly classed and its rollback behavior matches its class

stories.title: Emergency halt / kill switch
acceptance_criteria: Halting an in-flight execution transitions to ESCALATED_HUMAN_OVERRIDE with an auditable Evidence record and execution.halted event (F-11, spec §7A)
Halt never attempts automatic rollback on an already-completed action
required_halt_roles enforced via IdentityResolver

stories.title: Token & cost governance / budget enforcement
acceptance_criteria: An execution exceeding its OPC-configured budget escalates with BUDGET_EXCEEDED, never silently truncates (F-12)
Budget consumption written to the Evidence Ledger per execution

stories.title: Crash-recovery marker + status-check, end-to-end
acceptance_criteria: execution_step_marker written in the same transaction as the pre-execute state write, before the connector call (LLD §2)
operation_id is stable and reused across retries -- never regenerated per attempt
POST /internal/connectors/{connector_ref}/status-check implemented; a simulated crash mid-flight is recovered through EXECUTION_UNCERTAIN per LLD §7.2's sequence exactly
Automatic retry is prohibited when status is inconclusive and the action is not provably idempotent (ADR-004 fail-closed rule)

stories.title: Evidence Ledger persistence
acceptance_criteria: Append-only: a correction creates a new record with relationships.supersedes set, never an in-place update (F-15)
Cross-tenant leak test (two seeded tenants) returns zero rows for the wrong tenant on every table
retention_expires_at / retention_policy_version / legal_hold populated per ADR-011's finite dev default (90 days), explicitly labeled non-production

stories.title: Event model + outbox-pattern PlatformEvent emission
acceptance_criteria: outbox_event row inserted in the SAME transaction as the state+evidence write it accompanies (ADR-005, LLD §2)
A separate relay process publishes and marks published_at; consumers dedupe by the stable event_id, never the row id
Relay-lag alert ships with a configurable default threshold of 5 minutes, tenant-overridable (OI-LLD-02, folded in here per LLD §8's correction -- not a separate blocker)

stories.title: Confidence dimensions, itemized (no numeric rollup)
acceptance_criteria: All 5 already-defined dimensions (evidence coverage, hypothesis support, contradictory evidence, verification confidence, freshness) surfaced individually, never collapsed into one figure (F-17 MVP)
No numeric confidence percentage is displayed anywhere -- itemized dimensions are the entire confidence surface at this stage

stories.title: Role-separated review check + source-reliability + policy-certainty dimensions
acceptance_criteria: Role-separated reviewer receives only frozen plan + diff + tests + evidence -- explicitly NOT the generator's reasoning transcript (ADR-006)
Never described as 'independent review' in UI/docs -- 'role-separated' terminology enforced
Source reliability keyed to (tenant, connector_definition, connector_version), ordinal LOW|MEDIUM|HIGH|AUTHORITATIVE, not decimals (ADR-007)
Policy certainty is categorical from PolicyDecision.outcome (ALLOW|REQUIRE_APPROVAL|DENY) -- DENY never displayed as merely 'low confidence' (ADR-008)

stories.title: Control Tower minimal read API
acceptance_criteria: An execution's complete history reconstructable from Evidence Ledger records alone (F-16, spec §34 acceptance bar)
GET /tenants/{tenantId}/executions/{executionId}/context-package/composite implemented (LLD §6, OI-REQ-02) -- read-only join, zero ContextPackage schema change

stories.title: Version-binding read view
acceptance_criteria: Given an execution_id, a single query/view returns every element in LLD §0's version-binding table (F-20)
No new write path -- a read guarantee only, per OI-REQ-10's resolution

stories.title: Tenant activation gate
acceptance_criteria: POST /tenants/{tenantId}/onboarding/activate rejects unless retention_policy_confirmed_at is set AND no production-flagged execution path resolves through an is_development_principal identity (LLD §6, unifying ADR-011 + ADR-012)
Activation is a real technical gate, not documentation-only

stories.title: Declarative blast-radius scoring engine (5-component model)
acceptance_criteria: Scoring rules are declarative only -- no executable tenant code runs in the control plane (ADR-003)
Registered, versioned, deterministic, schema-validated, bounded input/time, hash-bound to the PolicyDecision, default-deny on evaluation failure
Produces all 5 named components (estimated_entities, environmental_criticality, compensation_class, data_sensitivity, customer_exposure) independently, never collapsed to one number

stories.title: EngineeringChangeExecutor
acceptance_criteria: Binds repo/branch/base-commit/file-scope allowlist from the FROZEN plan before any generation begins (ADR-002)
Invokes codegen+testgen via the shared runRealTestGate() module; enforces budget/timeout/retry limits
Produces a draft PR only -- never merges, never deploys
A material deviation from the frozen plan's bound scope invalidates authorization outright and forces replanning
Single approval gate verified: no second human-facing gate exists inside this executor

stories.title: Compensating-action rollback for code-change actions
acceptance_criteria: Rollback for a code-change action is a revert PR that re-enters the FULL governed pipeline (new ProposedAction, policy, approval) -- never an instant bypass (ADR-001, F-14 Post-MVP)

stories.title: Calibrated numeric confidence rollup
acceptance_criteria: A single numeric confidence figure is displayed ONLY once empirically calibrated against a defined minimum number of historical verified outcomes (spec §26, F-17 Post-MVP gate)
Before that threshold, itemized dimensions (E-03/E-04) remain the entire confidence surface -- no interim/placeholder percentage is ever shown
stories.defer_reason: Time-gated on real evidence volume, not a dependency graph gap -- revisit once E-03/E-04 have run against enough real tickets.

stories.title: First real context connector (Tenant #1 pilot system)
acceptance_criteria: Real logs/metrics connector against Tenant #1's actual platform, per spec Iteration 4

stories.title: First real action connector, real preflight/verification
acceptance_criteria: Real operational connector against Tenant #1's system, with real drift detection and real verification

stories.title: Real OBO identity-provider integration
acceptance_criteria: Concrete OIDC/SSO implementation behind IdentityResolver; at least one R2-class action runs under real ON_BEHALF_OF identity (F-09 real, ADR-012)

stories.title: Real secret-manager implementation
acceptance_criteria: Concrete SecretResolver implementation for Tenant #1's actual secret manager/cloud platform (ADR-009)

stories.title: Named approval-route / halt-role configuration
acceptance_criteria: Tenant policy config references real named individuals/teams for platform owner, security owner, senior on-call

stories.title: Real deployment target implementation
acceptance_criteria: Orchestration-specific manifests/pipeline for the confirmed target environment (ADR-010)

stories.title: Production retention decision + compliance-specific enforcement
acceptance_criteria: retention_policy_confirmed_at set from a real, documented tenant decision per class; enforcement (deletion/archival) implemented if the confirmed regime requires it (ADR-011)

stories.title: OPC shape 2: approval-gated operational mutation, config-only
acceptance_criteria: Runs on identical runtime code to the MVP's OPC, differing only in configuration -- zero runtime changes

stories.title: OPC shape 1: diagnostic-only, no mutating action
acceptance_criteria: Investigation/diagnosis only, config-only, zero runtime changes

stories.title: RAT-01: three structurally different OPCs, zero runtime branching
acceptance_criteria: All three shapes (diagnostic-only, approval-gated mutation, engineering-change/draft-PR) run on the same runtime with no scenario-specific code
This is the sharper genericity proof superseding spec §35's OPC A/B/C business-domain triad, per Requirements Revision 2's RAT-01
